title: Reading: True / False / Not Given
ringkas: Membedakan tiga jawaban yang paling sering menjebak

lesson.text: Soal **True / False / Not Given** adalah jenis soal Reading yang paling sering membuat peserta bingung. Kuncinya: **hanya percaya pada teks**, bukan pada pengetahuan atau pendapatmu.

lesson.title: 1. Arti tiga jawaban
table: teks menyatakan hal yang sama (dengan kata lain)
tidak ada informasi untuk memastikan benar atau salah

examples.en: [[The museum opens in the morning. → True]]

lesson.title: 2. Langkah menjawab
table: Garis bawahi kata kunci di pernyataan
Cari bagian teks yang membahas hal itu (sesuai urutan soal)
Bandingkan: sama, berlawanan, atau tidak ada?
Jika tidak ada informasi → Not Given

lesson.title: 3. Jebakan yang sering muncul
table: teks tidak menyebut, tapi kamu tahu itu benar
teks menyebut dua hal tapi tidak hubungannya

lesson.title: Beda False dan Not Given
lesson.text: **False**: ada informasi, tetapi berlawanan. **Not Given**: tidak ada informasi sama sekali. Tanyakan: apakah teks memberi tahu aku hal yang berbeda? Jika ya → False. Jika teks diam → Not Given.

lesson.title: Perhatikan kata penguat
lesson.text: Kata seperti *all, always, never, only, most, every, none* mengubah makna. Bandingkan dengan kata di teks: *some, sometimes, rarely, many*. Satu kata saja bisa mengubah True menjadi False.

read.title: Sleep and Memory
read.text:
Many students stay up late before exams, but research suggests this is a mistake. A study of two hundred university students found that those who slept eight hours remembered more words than those who slept only five hours.
During sleep, the brain organises new information and moves it into long-term memory. Researchers believe that this process is strongest during deep sleep, which occurs mainly in the first half of the night.
Some experts recommend a short nap in the afternoon, but they warn that naps longer than thirty minutes can make people feel tired rather than refreshed.
read.id:
Banyak mahasiswa begadang sebelum ujian, tetapi penelitian menunjukkan ini keliru. Sebuah studi terhadap dua ratus mahasiswa menemukan bahwa mereka yang tidur delapan jam mengingat lebih banyak kata daripada mereka yang tidur hanya lima jam.
Saat tidur, otak mengatur informasi baru dan memindahkannya ke memori jangka panjang. Peneliti percaya proses ini paling kuat saat tidur nyenyak, yang terjadi terutama di paruh pertama malam.
Beberapa ahli menyarankan tidur siang singkat, tetapi mereka memperingatkan bahwa tidur siang lebih dari tiga puluh menit dapat membuat orang merasa lelah, bukan segar.

qs.q: Students who slept eight hours remembered more words than those who slept five hours.
The study included students from several different countries.
qs.exp: Teks hanya menyebut "university students"; negara tidak disebut.

qs.q: Deep sleep happens mostly in the second half of the night.
Afternoon naps are always harmful.
qs.exp: Ahli menyarankan tidur siang singkat; hanya yang lebih dari 30 menit berisiko.

qs.q: Naps longer than thirty minutes can make people feel tired.
During sleep, new information moves into ___ memory. (two words)

read.title: The Growth of Online Shopping
read.text:
Online shopping has grown rapidly over the past decade. In 2015, about 10 percent of retail sales in the country took place online. By 2023, this figure had risen to 26 percent.
Shoppers say convenience is the main reason. They can compare prices at home, and goods are delivered to their door. However, returning products can be difficult, and some customers worry about the security of their payment details.
Local shops have responded in different ways. Some have created websites, while others focus on personal service to attract customers who prefer to visit in person.
read.id:
Belanja daring tumbuh pesat dalam satu dekade terakhir. Pada 2015, sekitar 10 persen penjualan ritel di negara itu terjadi daring. Pada 2023, angka itu naik menjadi 26 persen.
Para pembeli mengatakan kenyamanan adalah alasan utama. Mereka dapat membandingkan harga di rumah, dan barang diantar ke pintu. Namun, mengembalikan produk bisa sulit, dan sebagian pelanggan khawatir tentang keamanan data pembayaran.
Toko lokal menanggapinya dengan berbagai cara. Sebagian membuat situs web, sementara yang lain berfokus pada layanan pribadi untuk menarik pelanggan yang lebih suka datang langsung.

qs.q: Online sales were 26 percent of retail sales in 2023.
Most shoppers buy electronic goods online.
Returning products online is always easy.
Convenience is the main reason shoppers give for buying online.
All local shops have closed because of online shopping.
qs.exp: Teks: toko lokal menanggapi dengan berbagai cara.

qs.q: Some local shops focus on personal ___ . (one word)

read.title: Wildlife in Our Cities
read.text:
Many people assume that wild animals prefer the countryside, but several species are thriving in cities. Foxes, for example, have lived in British towns since the 1930s, and today an estimated 10,000 foxes live in London alone.
Cities offer food in the form of rubbish and garden birds, and they are warmer than the surrounding countryside, which helps small animals survive the winter. Some birds, such as pigeons, nest on buildings that resemble the cliffs where their ancestors lived.
However, urban wildlife also faces dangers. Traffic kills thousands of animals every year, and poisons used to control rats can harm other creatures. Researchers are now studying how cities can be designed to help wildlife, for instance by building green bridges over busy roads.

Banyak orang mengira satwa liar lebih menyukai pedesaan, tetapi beberapa spesies berkembang pesat di kota. Rubah, misalnya, telah hidup di kota-kota Inggris sejak 1930-an, dan kini diperkirakan 10.000 rubah hidup di London saja.
Kota menawarkan makanan berupa sampah dan burung kebun, dan lebih hangat daripada pedesaan sekitarnya, yang membantu hewan kecil bertahan di musim dingin. Beberapa burung, seperti merpati, bersarang di gedung yang menyerupai tebing tempat nenek moyang mereka hidup.
Namun, satwa liar perkotaan juga menghadapi bahaya. Lalu lintas membunuh ribuan hewan setiap tahun, dan racun yang dipakai untuk mengendalikan tikus dapat membahayakan makhluk lain. Peneliti kini mempelajari bagaimana kota dapat dirancang untuk membantu satwa liar, misalnya dengan membangun jembatan hijau di atas jalan sibuk.

read.title: Is Homework Useful?
read.text:
Many parents believe that homework helps children succeed. However, research on the subject is mixed. Some studies suggest that short homework tasks improve results in secondary school, while others find little benefit for younger children.
Teachers often set homework to practise skills learned in class. In my opinion, this makes sense only when the tasks are short and clearly connected to the lesson. Long, repetitive tasks can make children tired and reduce their interest in learning.
A growing number of schools now limit homework. In one Finnish school, pupils under ten receive none at all, yet their test scores remain among the highest in the world. This suggests that quality of teaching may matter more than the amount of homework.

Guru sering memberi PR untuk melatih keterampilan yang dipelajari di kelas. Menurut pendapat saya, ini masuk akal hanya bila tugasnya singkat dan jelas terkait pelajaran. Tugas panjang dan berulang dapat membuat anak lelah dan mengurangi minat belajar.

read.title: A Walking School Bus
read.text: In a small town in Wales, parents have started a walking school bus. A group of children walk to school together each morning, led by two adults who take turns. The children meet at set points along the route and join the group as it passes. The scheme began in 2019 with eight children and now includes forty. Parents say the children are fitter and arrive at school more awake. However, the scheme does not run on rainy days, when most families drive instead.
read.id: Di sebuah kota kecil di Wales, para orang tua memulai bus sekolah jalan kaki. Sekelompok anak berjalan bersama ke sekolah setiap pagi, dipimpin dua orang dewasa yang bergiliran. Anak-anak bertemu di titik-titik tertentu sepanjang rute dan bergabung dengan rombongan saat lewat. Program ini dimulai tahun 2019 dengan delapan anak dan kini mencakup empat puluh. Orang tua mengatakan anak-anak lebih bugar dan tiba di sekolah dengan lebih segar. Namun, program ini tidak berjalan pada hari hujan, ketika sebagian besar keluarga memilih mengemudi.
